answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents deposit stake to anchor their identity in a trust graph. In this architecture, an auditing lantern illuminates transactional discrepancies through topological cut verifications. When suspicious clusters form a spiral of collusive endorsements, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing slashes the culprits' collateral. Because dense cut validations scale superlinear attacker cost with each fabricated identity, mounting a Sybil swarm becomes economically ruinous.
